documents.title: Mutation testing
documents.text: Mutation testing changes production code slightly and checks whether tests fail. A surviving mutant needs a new assertion or a recorded decision.

documents.title: Coordinated omission
documents.text: Coordinated omission happens when a closed-loop load generator stops sending while the server stalls. Measure latency from the intended start time.

documents.title: Idempotency keys
documents.text: Retries without idempotency keys can double charge a customer. The provider stores one result per idempotency key.

documents.title: Flaky tests
documents.text: A flaky test passes and fails on the same code. Record the first attempt failure before any retry.

documents.title: Contract testing
documents.text: Consumer-driven contracts let a consumer publish expectations that the provider verifies before deploy.

documents.title: Service level objectives
documents.text: An SLO states a latency percentile and error budget for a workload. Warm-up requests are excluded from measurement.
